changelog: v0.7.5 - ClawTerminal: Claude Code terminal inside the ClawChat panel (auto-started ttyd on 127.0.0.1, dedicated ~/.RhinoClaw workspace with seeded MCP config, opt-in permissions toggle). Plus everything since 0.7.2: VisualARQ slab/space/roof verticals, localized viewport control, GH authoring conformance. Full notes: https://github.com/McMuff86/rhinoclaw/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
summary: Control Rhino 3D via the RhinoClaw plugin over TCP. Use whenever you need to create, modify, query, measure, or render 3D geometry, manage layers/materials, run Boolean and transform ops, drive Grasshopper definitions, work with VisualARQ BIM objects, or batch multiple steps as one atomic operation. Requires Rhino 7/8 running with `tcpstart` (the plugin's command line server) on the Rhino host.
